_doc: Our own wording for GUI keys that a dependency references but never defines. Each row is {"key": "STR_...", "text": "..."}; the text is written by us, never copied from a dependency. The key list comes from native RPT evidence (python3 -B -m tools.package.compat_stringtable --rpt <RPT> lists uncovered keys). Reviewed 2026-11-22 against the newest local server RPT: 14 dependency or item keys are covered here. The other 28 uncovered keys are vanilla engine UI keys (connection, loading, save, date and time, display-name and controller strings); a dedicated server does not load them and defining them here would override vanilla client text, so they are deliberately not provided. See docs/tools/COMPAT_ADDON.md.
